promptText: A locked-off screen recording of a premium mobile notification feed. The very thin frosted glass cards remain almost transparent, showing the exact black, purple and blue background through them. Rounded edges, subtle glass highlights. The notification stack scrolls upward naturally as though a person is scrolling with a finger. Start gently and continuously accelerate until the cards stream rapidly upward at the end, without easing out or pausing. New evenly spaced notification cards enter from below and older cards exit above. Keep the camera completely stationary, the background fixed, the card sizes and layout consistent. Crisp professional interface animation, no zoom or perspective change, no scene transition, no final title or new graphic. Preserve the supplied typography and marks as closely as possible.
